information_contract.pooling: every host step (every rollout call of targets_fn) and once at the terminal state: the union of all six UAVs' env._get_local_users views enters the team map (latest xy per user)
information_contract.trigger: re-plan iff the pooled known set (frozenset of user ids) differs from the set of the last plan (or no plan exists yet) and >= 6 users are known; layout cached by the known set; targets = layout[assign_targets(current positions, layout)] at every decision
information_contract.hold_rule: targets decided at t % 10 == 0 are held for 10 host steps; while fewer than 6 users are known every UAV's target is its spawn position
information_contract.planner_seed: constant --seed (the planner's world argument is only its RNG seed)
information_contract.shadow_user_set: known users only: deep copy of the live host with n_users = n_known and user_positions = the known users' latest sighted xy (index order), channel state recomputed by static_evaluate; unknown users are absent from k-means, association and reward; the host's own contract reward normalises C_bh by n_known (not by 50)
information_contract.sightings: every user env._get_local_users(i) returns (uncapped), read row by row

features.layout: 50 x [known, x/5000, y/5000] (user index order; unknown -> 0) + 6 x [x/5000, y/5000, (z-50)/100] (teacher.features without ego)

definitions.all_mean: mean C_bh over the 500 host steps of T_M
definitions.final_100_mean: mean C_bh over steps 400..499 of T_M
definitions.b04_B0_all_mean: committed b04 B0 all-500 C_bh (budget 3000, world-seeded planner)
definitions.tm_minus_b0: all_mean - b04_B0_all_mean (a reading, not a gate)
definitions.planner_calls: control plans (re-plans), one per distinct known set with >= 6 users
definitions.cache_hits: decisions with >= 6 known whose known set equals the last plan's set
definitions.assignment_changed: on a cache-hit decision: the assign_targets permutation differs from the previous decision's permutation (same cached layout); None on re-plan and hold decisions
definitions.hold_steps: host steps whose targets are the spawn positions because no plan exists
definitions.labelled_decisions: one per re-plan; layouts for every label seed
definitions.labels_z_all_50: every z of every labelled layout (all seeds) equals 50 m exactly
definitions.layout_box_faces: labelled-layout components within 1e-9 m of each face of the box
definitions.cpu_s.planner: process CPU inside the control-seed B4.plan_on_known calls
definitions.cpu_s.label_planner: process CPU inside the extra label-seed plan_on_known calls
definitions.cpu_s.rest: episode CPU minus planner, label planner and assignment
definitions.replay: per-decision targets replayed on a second fresh host under the same 10-step hold; C_bh and reward series asserted identical

cpu_projection.note: probe-mean basis: per-world CPU (T_M episode, label planners in label mode and the replay check) times the world count; applies to the mode and budget of this run
